molecularArtwork.method: Deterministic per-pixel depth-tested spherical atoms and cylindrical bonds composing several complete small molecules at varied scales and rigid rotations; the portal uses a horizontal alpha falloff across the top band, the FAQ a radial falloff. No inter-molecular bonds.
molecularArtwork.model: Decorative molecular drift of benzene (C6H6), ethane (C2H6), water (H2O) and idealized C8H18/C6H14 all-trans segments; illustrative ball-and-stick radii and colors, not electron density or identification of the extracted polymer.

shared.implementation: Empty decorative div inside PortalBackground; CSS raster background. Cards use a translucent top gradient (fading to opaque by 300px) so the artwork reads through the upper part of the top-right card on every route.

faq.implementation: Noninteractive ::before layer with proportional cover sizing; underlying card gradient also fills the card.

narrative.overview:
The user's pinned screenshot is the visual authority. The implemented portal uses a pale blue-gray canvas, softly raised white cards, rounded inset controls, dark blue gradient actions, and compact Chinese interface typography. This document records the current implementation; it introduces no product strategy or new brand metaphor.

The shared shell carries the same sidebar, background, card surfaces, and control treatments across portal routes. Native interactive UI remains the working interface; image crops supply the brand mark and decorative document detail, while large transparent PNG compositions supply light icy-blue molecular artwork, deterministically rendered from NIST experimental ethane coordinates.
keyCharacteristics: Cool layered pale surfaces with restrained blue accents.
Compact labels and strong card titles.
Soft exterior shadows and white inset highlights.
Shared navigation and background with route-specific content layouts.

rules.name: The Layered Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the implemented pale gradients and white highlights together; a flat white replacement loses the reference's material depth.

rules.name: The Shared Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep the same ambient card treatment across routes; reserve smaller inset highlights for controls and nested status panels.

dos: Do treat the pinned screenshot and final reference cascade as authority.
Do reuse the shared sidebar and decorative background.
Do preserve responsive layouts, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion handling.
Do scope Upload's fixed desktop card composition to Upload.
donts: Don't restore earlier legacy geometry over the reference theme.
Don't replace functional UI with a screenshot.
Don't introduce unrelated typography or card materials.
Don't infer unsupported product or brand commitments from imagery.

Do not invent molecular topology or stretch atom imagery. Use the deterministic PNG exports; preserve NIST ethane connectivity, rigid rotations, spherical atoms, cylindrical bonds, uniform orthographic scaling and fully contained molecules. Separate molecules have no inter-molecular bonds.
